import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, re

def fnum(s): return float(re.sub(r'[^0-9.\-]',' ',s).split()[0])

def extents(path):
    root=ET.parse(path).getroot()
    W=fnum(root.get('width')); H=fnum(root.get('height'))
    vb=root.get('viewBox')
    minx=miny=1e9; maxx=maxy=-1e9
    def pt(x,y):
        nonlocal minx,miny,maxx,maxy
        minx=min(minx,x);miny=min(miny,y);maxx=max(maxx,x);maxy=max(maxy,y)
    for el in root.iter():
        t=el.tag.split('}')[-1]
        if t=='rect':
            x=fnum(el.get('x','0'));y=fnum(el.get('y','0'));w=fnum(el.get('width','0'));h=fnum(el.get('height','0'))
            for xx in (x,x+w):
                for yy in (y,y+h): pt(xx,yy)
        elif t=='circle':
            cx=fnum(el.get('cx','0'));cy=fnum(el.get('cy','0'));r=fnum(el.get('r','0'))
            for dx in(-r,r):
                for dy in(-r,r): pt(cx+dx,cy+dy)
        elif t=='ellipse':
            cx=fnum(el.get('cx','0'));cy=fnum(el.get('cy','0'));rx=fnum(el.get('rx','0'));ry=fnum(el.get('ry','0'))
            for dx in(-rx,rx):
                for dy in(-ry,ry): pt(cx+dx,cy+dy)
        elif t=='line':
            pt(fnum(el.get('x1')),fnum(el.get('y1')));pt(fnum(el.get('x2')),fnum(el.get('y2')))
        elif t=='path':
            # numeric extent (NOTE: ignores arc bulge — conservative lower bound on extent)
            nums=[float(n) for n in re.findall(r'-?\d+\.?\d*',el.get('d',''))]
            if nums:
                xs=nums[0::2]; ys=nums[1::2]
                pt(min(xs),min(ys));pt(max(xs),max(ys))
    return W,H,vb,minx,miny,maxx,maxy
